task_definition.task_description: Please check whether flight AA100 is on time, look up the weather in New York, and get the details for Marriott New York. Then book a deluxe room at Marriott New York for Alex Johnson from 2026-01-10 to 2026-01-12, check Alice’s availability starting 2026-01-10, scan the bedroom devices and pick the smart lock, then unlock the main lock with PIN 2026 and send Alice a high-priority app alert saying the travel booking is complete and the destination room lock has been prepared.

user_input.query: Please check whether flight AA100 is on time, look up the weather in New York, and get the details for Marriott New York. Then book a deluxe room at Marriott New York for Alex Johnson from 2026-01-10 to 2026-01-12. Also check alice’s availability starting 2026-01-10 using calendar user ID u_alice. After that, scan the devices in the bedroom, choose the smart lock, and unlock the main lock lock_main with PIN 2026 so the lock state is unlock. Finally, send alice a high-priority app alert that says: “Travel booking is complete and the destination room lock has been prepared.”
user_input.alert_message: Travel booking is complete and the destination room lock has been prepared.
